decision_scope: Local reference availability for RflySim, Gazebo/Iris/PX4, Sunray/YunZong, FAST-LIO, EGO/Planner, ROS2 and timing-sync related assets.
claim_boundary: This manifest is local inventory only.
It does not decide adopt/adapt/reject project direction.
It does not validate runtime behavior.
It does not modify References content.

planning_record.department_local_goal: Return a local reference inventory manifest for RflySim/Gazebo/Sunray150-related dynamics/control/ROS2 flow.
critical_path_steps: Read task packet and required read-first documents.
Scan local References and current external-learning/research indexes for relevant RflySim, Gazebo/Iris/PX4, Sunray/YunZong, MID360/Livox, FAST-LIO, EGO/Planner and timing-sync candidates.
Classify each candidate as inventory_only and assign a likely downstream owner.
Write manifest and return packet under allowed write scope.
parallelizable_slices: Sunray/YunZong Gazebo model, launch and plugin inventory.
FAST-LIO/EGO/ROS2 planner and perception reference inventory.
planning_record.subagent_plan_reason: The task is local-only, bounded to inventory, and the relevant directories can be inspected inline without creating disposable subagents. Subagents would add coordination overhead and no extra authority.
verification_gates: All output paths are inside allowed_write_scope.
No network or Git remote commands were run.
Downstream owners are suggestions for evaluation, not adoption decisions.
manual_review_or_blocker_triggers: Need to inspect archive payloads beyond directory listings by extracting large zips.
Need to update or crawl upstream repositories.
Need to decide adoption, license compatibility, or technical route.
Need runtime validation in Gazebo, ROS2, MWORKS, UE or Sysplorer.

local_reference_roots.inventory_note: RflySim Advanced API archives and scene/application bundles are present locally; primary API material is inside zip archives.
Sunray local tree includes Gazebo simulation, Sunray150 models, MID360/D435i/3D lidar sensor models, PX4/MAVROS configs, FAST-LIO/EGO integration launchers and UAV control modules.
Lab local tree includes FAST_LIO, FAST-LIVO2, ego-planner, ego-planner-swarm, EGO-Planner-v2, SUPER, GCOPTER and Fast-Racing style planner/perception projects.
PX4 local tree includes PX4 source, mavros-ros2, mavlink, QGroundControl and SITL/MAVROS launch/test references.
